settings.heading: 7-day returns
settings.text: If you're not happy with your order, you can return any unopened, sealed product within 7 days of delivery for a full refund or exchange — no questions asked.

settings.heading: How to start a return
settings.text: Write to support@simplykids.in with your order number, or use the Contact Us form. Our team will arrange a reverse pickup where available, or share drop-off instructions.

settings.heading: Refunds
settings.text: Once we receive and inspect the returned item, refunds are processed to your original payment method within 5–7 business days. COD orders are refunded via bank transfer or UPI.

settings.heading: Damaged or incorrect items
settings.text: If your order arrives damaged or incorrect, contact us within 48 hours of delivery with photos, and we'll replace it at no extra cost.
